BiblicalUsage: Machats is a bruise, a contusion, and it appears once, in Isaiah 30:26, in the day the LORD binds up the breach of His people and heals the stroke of their wound.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the wound and the healing belong together in this verse: the same God who struck is the God who binds up.
